```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, fig.format = "pdf")
```


```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(viridis)
library(ggridges)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(vroom)
library(ggeffects)

all_colors <- viridis::viridis(10, option = "mako")
my_colors <- all_colors[c(3, 5, 7)]  # Selecting specific colors from the palette
```

# Load Pythia data



```{r include=FALSE}
## setwd("/Users/seantrott/Dropbox/UCSD/Research/NLMs/epistemology/mechinterp_generalizability/src/analysis")
directory_path <- "../../data/processed/induction_results_main/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
length(csv_files)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))


df_pythia_models <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model = sub("^EleutherAI/", "", mpath))  %>%
  mutate(step_modded = step + 1) %>%
  mutate(layer = layer + 1)
nrow(df_pythia_models)


table(df_pythia_models$mpath)



### Create head-level summaries
df_pythia_models_head_summaries = df_pythia_models %>%
  group_by(mpath, n_params, step, step_modded, model,
           layer, head) %>%
  summarise(mean_ps = mean(ps),
            mean_ar_acc = mean(ar_acc),
            mean_ar_rank = mean(ar_mean_rank))


```






# Final-step attention


## Induction heads: a summary

```{r induction_head_pos_main}



df_by_head_seed = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  group_by(mpath) %>%
  mutate(z_ps = scale(mean_ps)) 


### Max by layer
df_by_head_seed %>%
  group_by(mpath, head, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(max_mean = max(mean_ps)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = layer,
             y = head,
             fill = max_mean)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Head",
       fill = "Max Prefix-Matching Score") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Max Prefix-Matching Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(mpath, n_params), nrow = 2)


### Max by layer
df_by_head_seed %>%
  group_by(mpath, head, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(max_mean = max(z_ps)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = layer,
             y = head,
             fill = max_mean)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(x = "Layer",
       y = "Head",
       fill = "Max Prefix-Matching Score (z-scored)") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, 
                       name = "Max Prefix-Matching Score (z-scored)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # Keep facet labels horizontal
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(mpath, n_params), nrow =2)



### How does *max* attention per layer change across model size?
df_layerwise_attn <- df_by_head_seed %>%
  group_by(mpath, layer, n_params) %>%
  summarise(
    max_attention = max(z_ps),
    se_attention = sd(z_ps) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

### 
summary(lm(data = df_layerwise_attn,
             max_attention ~ log10(n_params) * layer))



### Relative layer
df_pythia_models_final_step = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  filter(step_modded == 143001) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(max_layer = max(layer),
         prop_layer = layer / max_layer) %>%
  ### Scale for interpreting the coefficients more easily
  mutate(prop_layer_scaled = scale(prop_layer)) %>%
  ungroup()


### Visualizing relative layer
summary_df <- df_pythia_models_final_step %>%
  mutate(binned_prop_layer = ntile(prop_layer, 6)) %>%
  mutate(prop_binned = binned_prop_layer / 6) %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, prop_binned) %>%
  summarise(
    max_ratio_per_seed = max(mean_ps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, prop_binned, n_params) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_max_ratio = mean(max_ratio_per_seed, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_max_ratio = sd(max_ratio_per_seed, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = prop_binned, y = avg_max_ratio, 
                       color = reorder(model, n_params))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(x = "Layer Depth",
       y = "Max Prefix-Matching Score",
       color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(8, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(8, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") 



### Analyses
summary(lmer(mean_ps ~ prop_layer + (1|head) + (1|model), 
             data = df_pythia_models_final_step))

```

## Peak layer depth


```{r pythia_main_peak_layer}
### Relative vs. absolute position

# Identify the layer with peak PS for each model
df_peak_layer = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, mpath, n_params) %>%
  mutate(max_layer = max(layer)) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(peak_layer_depth = layer / max_layer) %>%
  select(model, mpath, n_params, max_layer, peak_layer = layer, 
         peak_layer_depth) %>%
  ungroup()


### Relative layer depth
df_peak_layer %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = peak_layer_depth)) +
  geom_density(fill = my_colors[2], alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(df_peak_layer$peak_layer_depth),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_rug(length = unit(0.05, "npc")) +
  labs(x = "Relative layer depth of peak prefix-matching score",
       y = "Density") +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)

# How does the number of possible layers relate to 
# *peak relative layer* and *peak layer*?
m_relative = lm(peak_layer_depth ~ log10(max_layer), data = df_peak_layer)
m_absolute = lm(peak_layer ~ log10(max_layer), data = df_peak_layer)
summary(m_relative)  
summary(m_absolute) 



df_peak_layer %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = max_layer,
             y = peak_layer_depth)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Number of Layers (Log10)",
       y = "Layer Depth of Peak PS") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "none") 


```



# Attention over time

## Track AR Score

```{r ar_over_time_ar}

df_ar_by_step = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(mean_ar_acc = first(mean_ar_acc),
            mean_ar_rank = first(mean_ar_rank))


df_ar_by_step %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded,
             y = mean_ar_acc)) +
  geom_line(size = .6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step",
       y = "Associative Recall (Accuracy)",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000,
             linetype = "dotted",
             size = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(9, option = "mako",
                                                   begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params), nrow =2)



```



## Track Max Prefix Score

```{r ps_over_time_ps}
### Track max PS at each time point for each model (no seeds)
### Track max PS at each time point for each model (no seeds)
df_by_head_max_attention = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)

# Grand average across all models at each step
grand_avg <- df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  group_by(step_modded) %>%
  summarise(grand_mean = mean(mean_ps))

df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded,
             y = mean_ps)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +                     # per-model trajectory
  geom_line(data = grand_avg, aes(x = step_modded, y = grand_mean),
            color = "red", # linetype = "dotted", 
            size = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +  # grand mean
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step (Log10)",
       y = "Max Prefix-Matching Score",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dotted", size = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(9, option = "mako", 
                                                   begin = 0.85, end = 0.1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params), nrow =2)

summary(lm(data = df_by_head_max_attention,
           mean_ps ~ log10(step_modded) + log10(n_params)))
```

## PS and AR together


```{r ps_and_ar}
## PS and AR together

### Track max PS at each time point for each model (no seeds)
df_by_head_max_attention = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(model, n_params, step_modded, mean_ps, mean_ar_acc) %>%
  distinct()

### Reshape to long for plotting both metrics
df_combined = df_by_head_max_attention %>%
  select(model, n_params, step_modded, 
         `Max Prefix-Matching Score` = mean_ps,
         `Associative Recall (Accuracy)` = mean_ar_acc) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Max Prefix-Matching Score`, 
                        `Associative Recall (Accuracy)`),
               names_to = "metric",
               values_to = "value")

df_combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded,
             y = value,
             color = metric,
             linetype = metric)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step (Log10)",
       y = "Score",
       color = "",
       linetype = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dotted", size = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Max Prefix-Matching Score" = "#440154",
                                "Associative Recall (Accuracy)" = "#21918c")) +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params), nrow = 2)

```

# Compare 1-back and induction by model

```{r temporal_coordination_all}
### Track max previous token heads at each time point for each seed, across layer/head
df_by_head_max_attention_1back = df_pythia_models_1back_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_1back)

### Track max PS at each time point for each seed, across layer/head
df_by_head_max_attention_induction = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)

# Prep induction data
induction_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_induction %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_ps), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(max_val_scaled = (max_val - min(max_val)) / (max(max_val) - min(max_val))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(metric = "Induction (PS)")

# Prep 1-back data
oneback_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_1back %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_1back), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(max_val_scaled = (max_val - min(max_val)) / (max(max_val) - min(max_val))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(metric = "1-back Attention")

# Combine
combined <- bind_rows(induction_traj, oneback_traj)

# Averages across seeds
combined_avg <- combined %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_scaled = mean(max_val_scaled), .groups = "drop")

# Plot
combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded, y = max_val_scaled, 
             color = metric)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = combined_avg, 
            aes(x = step_modded, y = mean_scaled, color = metric, group = metric),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step",
       y = "Scaled max score (0-1)",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
scale_color_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "#E69F00", "Induction (PS)" = "#0072B2")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params), nrow=2)



### Compare AUC
auc_comparison <- combined %>%
  group_by(model, metric) %>%
  arrange(step_modded) %>%
  summarise(
    auc = sum(diff(log10(step_modded)) * (max_val_scaled[-1] + max_val_scaled[-n()]) / 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = auc)

# Paired test
t.test(auc_comparison$`1-back Attention`, auc_comparison$`Induction (PS)`, paired = TRUE)



### Without scaling
df_by_head_max_attention_1back = df_pythia_models_1back_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_1back)

### Track max PS at each time point for each model, across layer/head
df_by_head_max_attention_induction = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)

# Prep induction data — no scaling
induction_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_induction %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_ps), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Induction (PS)")

# Prep 1-back data — no scaling
oneback_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_1back %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_1back), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "1-back Attention")

# Combine
combined <- bind_rows(induction_traj, oneback_traj)

# Averages across models (for the bold trajectory)
combined_avg <- combined %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(max_val), .groups = "drop")

# Plot
combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded, y = max_val, 
             color = metric, group = interaction(model, metric))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = combined_avg, 
            aes(x = step_modded, y = mean_val, color = metric, group = metric),
            linewidth = 1.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step",
       y = "Max attention score",
       color = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "#E69F00", 
                                "Induction (PS)" = "#0072B2")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params), nrow = 2)


### Compare AUC (unscaled)
auc_comparison <- combined %>%
  group_by(model, metric) %>%
  arrange(step_modded) %>%
  summarise(
    auc = sum(diff(log10(step_modded)) * (max_val[-1] + max_val[-n()]) / 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = auc)

# Paired test
t.test(auc_comparison$`1-back Attention`, auc_comparison$`Induction (PS)`, paired = TRUE)




```


### Adding AR

```{r temporal_coordination_with_ar}
### Without scaling
df_by_head_max_attention_1back = df_pythia_models_1back_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_1back)

df_by_head_max_attention_first = df_pythia_models_1back_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_first)

df_by_head_max_attention_induction = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  slice_max(mean_ps)


### Prep data
induction_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_induction %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_ps), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "Induction (PS)")

oneback_traj <- df_by_head_max_attention_1back %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(mean_1back), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(metric = "1-back Attention")



# Prep AR data — no scaling
df_ar_traj = df_pythia_models_head_summaries %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded) %>%
  summarise(mean_ar_acc = first(mean_ar_acc), .groups = "drop")
ar_traj <- df_ar_traj %>%
  rename(max_val = mean_ar_acc) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Associative Recall (Acc)")

# Combine
combined <- bind_rows(induction_traj, oneback_traj, ar_traj)

# Averages across models
combined_avg <- combined %>%
  group_by(model, n_params, step_modded, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(max_val), .groups = "drop")

# Plot (unscaled)
combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step_modded, y = max_val, 
             color = metric, linetype = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Training Step",
       y = "Score",
       color = "",
       linetype = "") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "#E69F00", 
                                "Induction (PS)" = "#0072B2",
                                "Associative Recall (Acc)" = "#009E73")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("1-back Attention" = "solid",
                                   "Induction (PS)" = "solid",
                                   "Associative Recall (Acc)" = "dotted")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1.2) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~reorder(model, n_params), nrow = 2)
```
